trigger: User requires canonical Goli article IDs, transitive URL OR hash components, reject conflicting directions in a component.
canonical_url: For goli.tv/www.goli.tv /board/analysis/ID, normalize to https://www.goli.tv/board/analysis/ID, ignore query and fragment. Other URLs retain semantic queries.
components: Per exact frozen fixture, connect rows by canonical URL OR nonempty document SHA OR article-body SHA; transitive closure includes bridge rows even if they will not be retained. Site-scoped normalized author is an additional one-voter constraint.
conflicts: Reject all rows of any connected component with more than one direction. Never retain the first direction of a conflicting same-URL article.
representative: For consistent components, earliest input row, with old inputs placed before new inputs.
author_aliases: Normalize Unicode and whitespace within a site only. Cross-site display names are not identity evidence. No unproven aliases are merged.
content_comparison: Use existing local parsed units/nodes only: normalized full-projection SHA, exact shared prose units >=80 characters, 5-token shingle counts. These are diagnostics; incomplete projections or no matches do not establish independent human authorship.
new_record_status: New to electorate means no existing canonical URL/hash/verified identity component in supplied old vote inputs, not verified independent human opinion.
